verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a billing platform, but the evidence pack never documents a batch endpoint or a bulk action across many customers, invoices, or subscriptions. Invoice filtering, CSV export, the general plain-language AI agent and the per-customer Dunning Agent are adjacent features, not bulk operations. Per-item API calls and the OpenAPI schema are developer building blocks a user could script around, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
